notes: The catalog text ends partway through the Facilities Operations Technician Certificate of Achievement (page 135); the Green HVAC Commercial Certificate of Achievement section, which would follow alphabetically, is not in the text.

The BESP AS Degree prints 'Required Courses for Specialty in Green HVAC Commercial' (ACR 060, 061, 064, 065, 076, 078, 083, 084, 090; 3 units each). This is a degree specialty, not the certificate, so it was not recorded as the certificate's requirements. The closed list also includes ACR 75, ACR 77 and BIT 20, which that specialty list omits, so the certificate likely differs.
